[
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Luxor < Latin lux (light) + -or (agent suffix); compare lux, lucis",
    "reading": "The one who emits light; a bringer of illumination",
    "languages": ["la"],
    "source": "Lewis & Short, A Latin Dictionary",
    "confidence": 0.9
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "lu + xor; xor (logic) = exclusive or; lu = light in French 'lueur'",
    "reading": "Light that chooses between alternatives; a decisive gleam",
    "languages": ["fr", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Luxor ~ l'usure (Fr) = the usury; also l'os d'or (Fr) = the golden bone",
    "reading": "Golden bone worn by time; interest accruing on light itself",
    "languages": ["fr"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Luxor -> xolur; xol (Greek xylon = wood) + ur (primordial fire)",
    "reading": "Wood ignited by primal fire; the tree of dawn",
    "languages": ["grc", "de"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "L-U-X-O-R: Lux, Umbra, Xenos, Origo, Radius",
    "reading": "Light, shadow, stranger, origin, ray — a fivefold path of revelation",
    "languages": ["la", "grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "L (el = God in Hebrew) + U (you) + X (cross) + O (circle) + R (head)",
    "reading": "God in you, the cross within the circle, crowned by mind",
    "languages": ["he", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "L=30, U=400, X=600, O=70, R=200 (Greek isopsephy) -> sum 1300",
    "reading": "1300 = 13 x 100; 13 = death/rebirth, 100 = perfection — a threshold",
    "languages": ["grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "luk + sor; luk (Old English loc = enclosure) + sor (Latin soror = sister)",
    "reading": "Enclosed sisterhood; a locked feminine mystery",
    "languages": ["en", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  }
]
